6.126 rsMultiReportItemsInMatrixSection
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsMultiReportItemsInMatrixSection is a critical error that will occur if a DynamicColumns.ReportItems,
DynamicRows.ReportItems, or MatrixCell.ReportItems contains more than exactly one child element.
